newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-U.S. OPEN PRIZE MONEY TOPS $11 MILLION MARK.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-U.S. OPEN PRIZE MONEY TOPS $11 MILLION MARK.

text.p: The U.S. Open will award prize money totalling $11,821,890 this year, a record sum representing an increase of 8.54 percent over last year's prize pool, the U.S. Tennis Association said Wednesday.
The U.S. Open, which will unveil the new Arthur Ashe Stadium at the National Tennis Centre this year, will be held from August 25 through September 7.
As it has since 1973, the U.S. Open will offer equal prize money for men and women. It is the only Grand Slam tournament to do so.
Men's and women's singles champion will each earn $650,000, with runners-up collecting $350,000. Last year's champion's purse was $600,000.
Noteworthy changes in the prize money pool include a 61 percent increase in the mixed doubles purse and a doubling in prize money for players in doubles qualifying.
